name: @henrikogard/infomaniak-mcp

tools.name: kpaste_create
tools.description: Create an encrypted, ephemeral paste on kPaste (zero-knowledge, AES-256-GCM). Returns a URL with the decryption key in the fragment; only use with a trusted transcript and MCP client.

password.description: Optional extra paste password. Treat it as transcript-visible secret material; prefer sharing it through a different channel.

tools.name: kpaste_read
tools.description: Read and decrypt a kPaste URL using the fragment key. This is marked destructive because burn-after-reading pastes may be consumed by the read. Requires exact confirmation: ACKNOWLEDGE KPASTE READ RISK.

url.description: Full kPaste URL including the # fragment decryption key

password.description: Optional paste password when the paste is password-protected

confirmation.description: Exact confirmation phrase: ACKNOWLEDGE KPASTE READ RISK

tools.name: infomaniak_help
tools.description: List the currently available Infomaniak MCP tools with service groups, argument names, safety/risk labels, usage hints, and safe workflow suggestions. Use this first when the user asks what this MCP can do, which tools exist, or how it can help.

service.description: Optional service/category to focus on. Defaults to all.

include_tools.description: Include individual tool names and descriptions. Defaults to true.
